part.text:
I'll create a detailed animated SVG construction scene with a sloth operating an excavator.
```svg
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 800" width="1200" height="800">
  <title>Sloth Operating an Excavator</title>

  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="skyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#4EA9E0"/>
      <stop offset="0.38" stop-color="#96D2EF"/>
      <stop offset="0.72" stop-color="#D6ECF3"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FCEBC4"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="sunGlow" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.5">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFE680" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#FFD84D" stop-opacity="0.42"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFD84D" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="sunCore" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFF6B8"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFC12E"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cloudGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
      <stop offset="0.7" stop-color="#EDF6FC"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#D3E5F2"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hillGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#AFD49B"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#84B67B"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hillGrad2" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#93C089"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#6DA06B"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="groundGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#E3BE88"/>
      <stop offset="0.22" stop-color="#D1A365"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#9E7039"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="dirtGrad" x1="0.15" y1="0" x2="0.85" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#CE9560"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#AE7A44"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#82552C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bodyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFDE63"/>
      <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#F5C21A"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#CE9704"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cabGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.3" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFE37A"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#F7C622"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#D9A106"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="armGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFD84D"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#D89F06"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="metalGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#9A9A9A"/>
      <stop offset="0.4" stop-color="#D8D8D8"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#6E6E6E"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="glassGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#DCF0F9"/>
      <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#A9D5E8"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7FB6D4"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="furGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#AB9070"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7A6145"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="vestGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFA53A"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#F26B00"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="trackGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#3A3A3A"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#1E1E1E"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <clipPath id="cabWin">
      <path d="M 388,452 L 388,352 Q 388,334 408,330 L 496,320 Q 522,318 528,342 L 530,452 Z"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <!-- ================= SKY ================= -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1200" height="800" fill="url(#skyGrad)"/>

  <!-- ================= SUN ================= -->
  <g transform="translate(140,120)">
    <circle r="135" fill="url(#sunGlow)"/>
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="60s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <g stroke="#FFDD66" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8">
        <line x1="0" y1="-72" x2="0" y2="-98"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-72" x2="0" y2="-98" transform="rotate(30)"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-72" x2="0" y2="-98" transform="rotate(60)"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-72" x2="0" y2="-98" transform="rotate(90)"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-72" x2="0" y2="-98" transform="rotate(120)"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-72" x2="0" y2="-98" transform="rotate(150)"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-72" x2="0" y2="-98" transform="rotate(180)"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-72" x2="0" y2="-98" transform="rotate(210)"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-72" x2="0" y2="-98" transform="rotate(240)"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-72" x2="0" y2="-98" transform="rotate(270)"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-72" x2="0" y2="-98" transform="rotate(300)"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-72" x2="0" y2="-98" transform="rotate(330)"/>
      </g>
    </g>
    <circle r="56" fill="url(#sunCore)"/>
    <circle r="56" fill="none" stroke="#FFED9B" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="-17" cy="-19" rx="21" ry="14" fill="#FFFBDA" opacity="0.6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ================= CLOUDS ================= -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;28 0;0 0" dur="19s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g fill="url(#cloudGrad)">
      <ellipse cx="250" cy="152" rx="46" ry="30"/>
      <ellipse cx="298" cy="160" rx="38" ry="23"/>
      <ellipse cx="206" cy="162" rx="34" ry="21"/>
      <ellipse cx="258" cy="140" rx="33" ry="26"/>
    </g>
    <ellipse cx="258" cy="176" rx="60" ry="8" fill="#C6DCEB" opacity="0.35"/>
  </g>

  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;-34 0;0 0" dur="26s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g fill="url(#cloudGrad)">
      <ellipse cx="700" cy="100" rx="54" ry="32"/>
      <ellipse cx="752" cy="112" rx="42" ry="24"/>
      <ellipse cx="650" cy="114" rx="36" ry="21"/>
      <ellipse cx="706" cy="88" rx="38" ry="28"/>
    </g>
    <ellipse cx="706" cy="128" rx="68" ry="8" fill="#C6DCEB" opacity="0.35"/>
  </g>

  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0;22 0;0 0" dur="15s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g fill="url(#cloudGrad)">
      <ellipse cx="985" cy="196" rx="40" ry="24"/>
      <ellipse cx="1024" cy="204" rx="32" ry="18"/>
      <ellipse cx="950" cy="206" rx="28" ry="17"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ================= BIRD ================= -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="-90 150;420 118;900 138;1310 100" dur="24s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="scale" values="1 1;1 0.45;1 1" dur="0.55s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <path d="M -20,0 Q -10,-11 0,0 Q 10,-11 20,0" fill="none" stroke="#41525E" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ================= DISTANT HILLS ================= -->
  <g>
    <path d="M -40,615 Q 140,472 330,615 Z" fill="url(#hillGrad)"/>
    <path d="M 240,615 Q 430,505 640,615 Z" fill="url(#hillGrad2)"/>
    <path d="M 560,615 Q 760,468 990,615 Z" fill="url(#hillGrad)"/>
    <path d="M 900,615 Q 1090,510 1260,615 Z" fill="url(#hillGrad2)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- distant crane silhouette -->
  <g opacity="0.42" fill="#7FA3B4">
    <rect x="86" y="428" width="9" height="190"/>
    <rect x="40" y="440" width="150" height="6"/>
    <rect x="86" y="418" width="46" height="26"/>
    <rect x="88" y="470" width="60" height="5"/>
    <rect x="34" y="440" width="20" height="14"/>
    <line x1="150" y1="446" x2="150" y2="500" stroke="#7FA3B4" stroke-width="3"/>
    <rect x="142" y="500" width="16" height="10"/>
    <line x1="86" y1="446" x2="120" y2="420" stroke="#7FA3B4" stroke-width="3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ================= GROUND ================= -->
  <rect x="0" y="600" width="1200" height="200" fill="url(#groundGrad)"/>
  <path d="M 0,600 Q 200,590 400,602 Q 620,616 820,600 Q 1020,586 1200,600 L 1200,640 L 0,640 Z" fill="#B98F55" opacity="0.55"/>

  <!-- ground texture -->
  <g fill="#8C6234" opacity="0.32">
    <ellipse cx="120" cy="668" rx="16" ry="5"/>
    <ellipse cx="330" cy="742" rx="22" ry="6"/>
    <ellipse cx="540" cy="700" rx="14" ry="4"/>
    <ellipse cx="720" cy="760" rx="26" ry="7"/>
    <ellipse cx="960" cy="748" rx="20" ry="6"/>
    <ellipse cx="1120" cy="676" rx="15" ry="5"/>
    <ellipse cx="60" cy="750" rx="18" ry="5"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#E7C898" opacity="0.4">
    <ellipse cx="220" cy="700" rx="9" ry="3"/>
    <ellipse cx="470" cy="676" rx="11" ry="3"/>
    <ellipse cx="640" cy="730" rx="8" ry="3"/>
    <ellipse cx="1050" cy="716" rx="10" ry="3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- grass tufts on the horizon -->
  <g stroke="#7FAE6B" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.85">
    <path d="M 60,604 q 4,-12 8,-16 M 68,604 q 2,-12 0,-19 M 76,604 q -3,-11 -8,-16"/>
    <path d="M 700,600 q 4,-12 8,-16 M 708,600 q 2,-12 0,-19 M 716,600 q -3,-11 -8,-16"/>
    <path d="M 1160,602 q 4,-12 8,-16 M 1168,602 q 2,-12 0,-19 M 1176,602 q -3,-11 -8,-16"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ================= DIRT PILE ================= -->
  <g>
    <path d="M 780,712 C 800,622 830,520 900,495 C 980,470 1052,530 1092,610 C 1122,662 1146,692 1158,712 Z" fill="url(#dirtGrad)"/>
    <path d="M 800,712 C 818,628 848,542 902,512 C 922,502 946,499 966,505 C 906,522 852,602 832,712 Z" fill="#DDAE74" opacity="0.5"/>
    <path d="M 1040,540 C 1082,580 1116,650 1140,712 L 1158,712 C 1146,682 1122,620 1092,578 Z" fill="#6B4522" opacity="0.35"/>
    <path d="M 860,600 C 890,575 930,560 970,562" stroke="#8A5C31" stroke-width="3" fill="none" opacity="0.4"/>
    <path d="M 900,650 C 940,628 990,620 1030,632" stroke="#8A5C31" stroke-width="3" fill="none" opacity="0.35"/>
    <g fill="#96673A" opacity="0.6">
      <ellipse cx="880" cy="676" rx="14" ry="8"/>
      <ellipse cx="1010" cy="684" rx="18" ry="9"/>
      <ellipse cx="1094" cy="690" rx="12" ry="7"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="#D9AC74" opacity="0.65">
      <ellipse cx="952" cy="540" rx="9" ry="5"/>
      <ellipse cx="1002" cy="562" rx="7" ry="4"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ================= EXCAVATOR ================= -->
  <!-- TRACKS -->
  <g>
    <rect x="220" y="596" width="510" height="96" rx="48" fill="url(#trackGrad)" stroke="#141414" stroke-width="5"/>
    <path d="M 268,596 H 682 A 48,48 0 0 1 682,692 H 268 A 48,48 0 0 1 268,596 Z"
          fill="none" stroke="#5A5A5A" stroke-width="10" stroke-dasharray="16 14">
      <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" from="0" to="-60" dur="1.3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </path>
    <rect x="242" y="614" width="466" height="60" rx="30" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <rect x="242" y="614" width="466" height="22" rx="11" fill="#5A5A5A" opacity="0.6"/>

    <!-- middle rollers -->
    <g fill="#6E6E6E">
      <circle cx="340" cy="644" r="21"/>
      <circle cx="410" cy="644" r="21"/>
      <circle cx="480" cy="644" r="21"/>
      <circle cx="550" cy="644" r="21"/>
      <circle cx="620" cy="644" r="21"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="#3D3D3D">
      <circle cx="340" cy="644" r="8"/>
      <circle cx="410" cy="644" r="8"/>
      <circle cx="480" cy="644" r="8"/>
      <circle cx="550" cy="644" r="8"/>
      <circle cx="620" cy="644" r="8"/>
    </g>

    <!-- drive sprocket (rear) -->
    <g transform="translate(268,644)">
      <circle r="34" fill="#6E6E6E"/>
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="3.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <circle r="25" fill="none" stroke="#4B4B4B" stroke-width="6" stroke-dasharray="9 8"/>
        <line x1="-22" y1="0" x2="22" y2="0" stroke="#4B4B4B" stroke-width="5"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-22" x2="0" y2="22" stroke="#4B4B4B" stroke-width="5"/>
        <circle r="7" fill="#3D3D3D"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- idler (front) -->
    <g transform="translate(682,644)">
      <circle r="34" fill="#6E6E6E"/>
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0" to="360" dur="3.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <circle r="25" fill="none" stroke="#4B4B4B" stroke-width="6" stroke-dasharray="9 8"/>
        <line x1="-22" y1="0" x2="22" y2="0" stroke="#4B4B4B" stroke-width="5"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-22" x2="0" y2="22" stroke="#4B4B4B" stroke-width="5"/>
        <circle r="7" fill="#3D3D3D"/>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ROTATING UPPER STRUCTURE (body + cab + arm) -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-2 480 560;2.4 480 560;-2 480 560" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite" calcMode="spline" keySplines="0.45 0 0.55 1;0.45 0 0.55 1"/>

    <!-- BODY -->
    <path d="M 300,600 L 300,502 Q 300,466 338,466 L 646,466 Q 688,466 692,508 L 700,600 Z" fill="url(#bodyGrad)"/>
    <path d="M 300,600 L 300,502 Q 300,466 338,466 L 382,466 L 382,600 Z" fill="#D9A400"/>
    <path d="M 300,600 L 300,502 Q 300,466 338,466 L 350,466 L 350,600 Z" fill="#C08F00" opacity="0.6"/>

    <!-- engine deck -->
    <rect x="376" y="452" width="266" height="22" rx="10" fill="#EFBB18"/>
    <rect x="376" y="452" width="266" height="8" rx="4" fill="#FFD95C" opacity="0.7"/>
    <g stroke="#B58A00" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.7" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="400" y1="466" x2="440" y2="466"/>
      <line x1="456" y1="466" x2="496" y2="466"/>
      <line x1="512" y1="466" x2="552" y2="466"/>
      <line x1="568" y1="466" x2="608" y2="466"/>
    </g>

    <!-- body shading and panel lines -->
    <path d="M 360,600 L 360,500" stroke="#C89400" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.6"/>
    <path d="M 560,600 L 560,478" stroke="#C89400" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.5"/>
    <path d="M 300,588 L 700,588" stroke="#B58400" stroke-width="4" opacity="0.55"/>
    <rect x="590" y="500" width="90" height="56" rx="8" fill="#E8B415" stroke="#C08F00" stroke-width="3"/>
    <circle cx="612" cy="514" r="5" fill="#B08000"/>
    <circle cx="612" cy="534" r="5" fill="#B08000"/>

    <!-- exhaust pipe -->
    <rect x="336" y="398" width="16" height="60" rx="5" fill="url(#metalGrad)"/>
    <rect x="329" y="390" width="30" height="13" rx="6" fill="#8C8C8C"/>
    <rect x="329" y="390" width="30" height="5" rx="3" fill="#C4C4C4"/>

    <!-- boom mounting bracket -->
    <path d="M 590,470 L 660,470 L 650,530 L 600,530 Z" fill="#D9A400"/>
    <circle cx="620" cy="450" r="19" fill="#B8860B"/>
    <circle cx="620" cy="450" r="9" fill="#8A6508"/>

    <!-- ================= BOOM / STICK / BUCKET ================= -->
    <g transform="translate(620,450)">
      <g>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
          values="-4 0 0;6 0 0;-4 0 0" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"
          calcMode="spline" keySplines="0.45 0 0.55 1;0.45 0 0.55 1"/>

        <!-- boom -->
        <path d="M -13.5,-17.4 L 13.5,17.4 L 189.2,-128.2 L 170.8,-151.8 Z" fill="url(#armGrad)" stroke="#B8860B" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <path d="M 13.5,17.4 L 189.2,-128.2" stroke="#FFE887" stroke-width="4" opacity="0.75"/>
        <path d="M -13.5,-17.4 L 170.8,-151.8" stroke="#B47F00" stroke-width="4" opacity="0.6"/>

        <!-- hydraulic ram on boom -->
        <rect x="26" y="-38" width="110" height="15" rx="7" transform="rotate(-37 26 -38)" fill="url(#metalGrad)" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>
        <rect x="120" y="-72" width="52" height="9" rx="4" transform="rotate(-37 120 -72)" fill="#E9E9E9" stroke="#6E6E6E" stroke-width="2"/>

        <!-- boom pivot pin -->
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="15" fill="#C08F00"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="7" fill="#7E5C05"/>

        <g transform="translate(180,-140)">
          <g>
            <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
              values="18 0 0;-14 0 0;18 0 0" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"
              calcMode="spline" keySplines="0.45 0 0.55 1;0.45 0 0.55 1"/>

            <!-- stick -->
            <path d="M -15.4,7.2 L 15.4,-7.2 L 80.9,144.9 L 59.1,155.1 Z" fill="url(#armGrad)" stroke="#B8860B" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
            <path d="M 15.4,-7.2 L 80.9,144.9" stroke="#FFE887" stroke-width="4" opacity="0.75"/>
            <path d="M -15.4,7.2 L 59.1,155.1" stroke="#B47F00" stroke-width="4" opacity="0.6"/>
            <path d="M 18,30 L 68,120" stroke="#D9A400" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.6"/>

            <!-- stick hydraulic -->
            <rect x="4" y="10" width="14" height="60" rx="6" transform="rotate(-10 4 10)" fill="url(#metalGrad)" stroke="#5E5E5E" stroke-width="2"/>

            <!-- elbow pin -->
            <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="14" fill="#C08F00"/>
            <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="#7E5C05"/>

            <g transform="translate(70,150)">
              <g>
                <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
                  values="-20 0 0;25 0 0;-20 0 0" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"
                  calcMode="spline" keySplines="0.45 0 0.55 1;0.45 0 0.55 1"/>

                <!-- bucket -->
                <path d="M -12,-10 L 18,-8 C 38,2 48,28 44,54 L 44,64 L -22,64 C -36,38 -30,10 -12,-10 Z"
                      fill="#E0AC16" stroke="#A87A05" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
                <path d="M -12,-10 L 18,-8 C 34,0 44,20 42,40 C 30,22 8,10 -12,-10 Z" fill="#FFDA55" opacity="0.6"/>
                <path d="M -22,64 L 44,64" stroke="#8A6508" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

                <!-- teeth -->
                <g fill="#7A5A08">
                  <path d="M -22,64 L -16,64 L -19,78 Z"/>
                  <path d="M -8,64 L -2,64 L -5,78 Z"/>
                  <path d="M 6,64 L 12,64 L 9,78 Z"/>
                  <path d="M 20,64 L 26,64 L 23,78 Z"/>
                  <path d="M 34,64 L 40,64 L 37,78 Z"/>
                </g>

                <!-- dirt in bucket -->
                <path d="M -18,62 Q 8,44 40,62 Z" fill="#A5743E"/>
                <path d="M -12,62 Q 8,50 34,62 Z" fill="#C08F55"/>

                <!-- bucket pin -->
                <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="11" fill="#C08F00"/>
                <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="5" fill="#7E5C05"/>
              </g>
            </g>
          </g>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- ================= CAB ================= -->
    <path d="M 372,462 L 372,344 Q 372,318 398,314 L 500,303 Q 540,300 546,338 L 552,462 Z" fill="url(#cabGrad)" stroke="#C08F00" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M 372,462 L 372,344 Q 372,318 398,314 L 410,313 L 410,462 Z" fill="#D9A400" opacity="0.7"/>

    <!-- window glass base -->
    <path d="M 388,452 L 388,352 Q 388,334 408,330 L 496,320 Q 522,318 528,342 L 530,452 Z" fill="url(#glassGrad)"/>

    <!-- interior -->
    <g clip-path="url(#cabWin)">
      <!-- seat -->
      <path d="M 384,462 L 384,404 Q 384,392 398,392 L 424,392 L 424,462 Z" fill="#3E4A50"/>
      <rect x="380" y="440" width="60" height="24" rx="8" fill="#2F383D"/>

      <!-- sloth torso -->
      <path d="M 412,462 L 412,412 Q 412,396 430,394 L 470,394 Q 490,396 490,414 L 490,462 Z" fill="url(#furGrad)"/>
      <!-- vest -->
      <path d="M 414,462 L 414,414 Q 414,400 430,398 L 470,398 Q 488,400 488,416 L 488,462 Z" fill="url(#vestGrad)"/>
      <path d="M 414,462 L 414,414 Q 414,400 430,398 L 438,398 L 438,462 Z" fill="#FFBE6B" opacity="0.55"/>
      <rect x="414" y="424" width="74" height="9" fill="#E9F2F8" opacity="0.92"/>
      <rect x="414" y="444" width="74" height="9" fill="#E9F2F8" opacity="0.92"/>
      <rect x="414" y="424" width="74" height="3" fill="#B9CBD8" opacity="0.8"/>
```
